name: Spiko (EUTBL / USTBL money market funds)
issuer: Spiko (Paris, France) — AMF-regulated fund manager; funds are French UCITS money market funds
underlying: Short-term French/EU and US government Treasury bills held in AMF-approved UCITS money market funds (EUTBL holds euro-denominated EU T-bills, USTBL holds US T-bills), with CACEIS as custodian.

terms.min_investment: €/$1,000 on the first subscription only; subsequent orders and redemptions from €/$1
terms.jurisdiction: France-domiciled UCITS regulated by the AMF; open to EU/EEA retail individuals and businesses — the key differentiator: a genuinely retail-accessible EU-regulated tokenized MMF. Not offered to US persons.
terms.redemption: Daily subscriptions/redemptions at NAV; order cut-off 10:30 CET, executed on next known NAV (T+0/T+1 settlement); minimum redemption €1
terms.fees: 0.25%/yr management (EUTBL), 0.30%/yr (USTBL); 0% subscription and 0% redemption fees; yields quoted net of fees (~2.1-2.6% EUR, ~3.7-4.1% USD as of Aug 2026)

how_to_invest.method: Spiko app — open an account in ~5 minutes (KYC), deposit EUR/USD via bank transfer or stablecoins

risk_notes: Regulated UCITS short-term VNAV money market fund, so credit risk is essentially sovereign T-bill risk plus fund/custodian operational risk; NAV is variable (not a hard $1 peg) and yields track ECB/Fed short rates. Token layer adds smart-contract and chain-bridge risk across 7 networks.

name: OpenEden TBILL Vault
issuer: OpenEden — TBILL tokens issued by Treasury Bills Institutional Liquidity Limited, a BVI FSC-regulated professional fund
underlying: Short-dated US Treasury bills (~99% of portfolio, maturities under 6 months) plus a small allocation to an AAAm-rated Treasury money market fund; rated AA+f/S1+ by S&P.

terms.min_investment: First deposit 100,000 USDC minimum; subsequent deposits from 1 USDC
terms.jurisdiction: BVI professional fund; open to Accredited/Professional Investors globally (KYC/AML onboarding required); not a retail product
terms.redemption: On-chain redemption to USDC at NAV, minimum redemption 1 USDC; near-instant/24-7 via smart contract subject to liquidity
terms.fees: 0.30%/yr total expense ratio + 0.05% (5 bps) transaction fee on redemptions

how_to_invest.method: OpenEden app — onboard as accredited/professional investor, deposit USDC

risk_notes: Underlying is high-quality (S&P AA+f rated) but access is permissioned: TBILL is non-transferable to non-whitelisted wallets, so no secondary-market exit — you depend on OpenEden's redemption mechanism and the BVI fund structure. Most supply now sits on BNB Chain (~$202M of $247M).

name: WisdomTree Government Money Market Digital Fund (WTGXX) / WisdomTree Connect
issuer: WisdomTree Digital Trust / WisdomTree, Inc. (NYSE: WT), SEC-registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940
underlying: A '40-Act US government money market fund holding short-term US government securities and repos, targeting a stable $1.00 NAV, with fund shares recorded as tokens on public blockchains.

terms.jurisdiction: US only — SEC-registered fund offered to US persons via WisdomTree Prime (retail app, most US states) and WisdomTree Connect (institutional/business)
terms.redemption: Daily at $1.00 stable NAV; 24/7 trading and instant settlement being rolled out via WisdomTree Connect; standard MMF gates/fees can apply in stress
terms.fees: 0.25% expense ratio; no subscription/redemption fees in normal conditions

how_to_invest.method: WisdomTree Connect (institutions/businesses, wallet-based access, 13 tokenized funds)

risk_notes: Strongest regulatory wrapper of the group (SEC-registered '40-Act MMF from a public asset manager), but geographically inverted vs Spiko: US-persons only, so inaccessible to EU retail. Stable-NAV MMF risk applies — $1.00 is targeted, not guaranteed, and redemption fees/gates can be imposed. DeFiLlama TVL (~$1.03B) covers WisdomTree's tokenized fund suite.

name: Midas mTBILL
issuer: Midas (regulated German/European tokenization platform; tokens issued as ISIN-bearing tracker certificates under European law)
underlying: A tokenized certificate tracking short-term US Treasury exposure, primarily via BlackRock's iShares $ Treasury Bond 0-1yr UCITS ETF held with regulated custodians; sister token mBASIS instead tracks a crypto basis-trade strategy (not treasuries).

terms.min_investment: No stated minimum currently (rwa.xyz lists 0 USDC); earlier instant-mint tiers had higher thresholds
terms.jurisdiction: Non-US (and non-UK) persons only; KYC/AML 'greenlisting' required to mint/redeem; EU-friendly but not a UCITS fund — it's a debt certificate on Midas
terms.redemption: Instant on-chain mint/redeem vs USDC at NAV via Midas smart contracts (subject to liquidity buffer); primary redemption otherwise processed against the underlying ETF
terms.fees: 0% management/issuance fees; rwa.xyz lists 0% redemption, historical docs cite ~15 bps redemption fee on primary redemption; ETF TER borne inside NAV

how_to_invest.method: Midas app — connect wallet, complete KYC greenlisting, mint mTBILL with USDC (geo-blocked for US/UK)
Secondary DeFi markets (mTBILL is a permissionless-transfer ERC-20 once issued)

risk_notes: You hold a certificate (debt claim) on Midas that tracks a BlackRock T-bill ETF — issuer/structure risk sits above the sovereign risk, unlike direct fund shares. mTBILL itself is ~$71M; the larger DeFiLlama figure is all Midas products including mBASIS and vault strategies with very different risk profiles.

name: OpenTrade Yield Vaults
issuer: OpenTrade (UK; works with an FCA-regulated asset manager; investment-committee-reviewed vaults)
underlying: Stablecoin (USDC/EURC) vaults whose deposits are deployed into US Treasury bills, money market funds and other institutional fixed-income/RWA strategies via regulated asset managers, paying yield back on-chain.

terms.min_investment: Varies by vault/partner — e.g. from 1 USDC on partner integrations (IXS), ~$100 on InvestaX Earn; direct OpenTrade relationships are negotiated B2B
terms.jurisdiction: B2B: onboards exchanges, neobanks, fintechs, wallets and institutional investors (non-US focus); retail reaches it only indirectly through partner apps (e.g. Criptan, Littio, IXS, El Dorado) which run their own KYC
terms.redemption: Daily/flexible entry-exit with no lockups on core USDC treasury vaults; settlement typically T+0/T+1 through partner rails
terms.lockup: None on flexible-term vaults; fixed-term products exist
terms.fees: Not publicly standardized — spread/management fees are embedded per-vault and per-partner agreement

how_to_invest.method: Indirectly as retail via partner apps that embed OpenTrade yield (own KYC per app)

risk_notes: Infrastructure/B2B layer rather than a fund you buy directly — end users carry both OpenTrade's structure risk and their partner platform's counterparty risk, and fee/yield terms are opaque compared with Spiko/WisdomTree. Underlying treasury vaults are conservative; newer vaults (private credit, staking-powered yield) are not treasury risk.

name: Hastra (wYLDS / PRIME)
issuer: Hastra — a DeFi liquidity protocol incubated by Figure Technology (NYSE-listed) and the Provenance Blockchain Foundation; Hastra itself is not a registered fund issuer
underlying: NOT treasuries: wYLDS is a wrapper backed 1:1 by YLDS, Figure's SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin (a face-amount certificate), and PRIME/AUTO stake wYLDS into yield from Figure's Democratized Prime HELOC and auto-loan lending pools — consumer-credit yield, not T-bills.

terms.jurisdiction: Permissionless DeFi protocol (US-linked via Figure/YLDS's SEC registration, but Hastra tokens themselves are unregistered; standard sanctioned-jurisdiction restrictions in ToS)
terms.redemption: On-chain: swap/claim wYLDS back toward YLDS via redemption vaults; unstake PRIME/AUTO to wYLDS. Distributions are variable and not guaranteed
terms.lockup: None stated for wYLDS; staking tokens redeem back to wYLDS
terms.fees: No on-chain protocol fee; Figure monetizes via off-chain lending spreads. wYLDS ~3.3% APY, PRIME ~5.7% APY (variable)

how_to_invest.method: hastra.io app — connect a Solana or Ethereum wallet, acquire wYLDS, optionally stake for PRIME/AUTO

risk_notes: Legitimate provenance (incubated by publicly-traded Figure, Dec-2025 RWA Consortium with Solana/Chainlink partners) but NOT a tokenized-treasury vault: yield comes from HELOC/auto-loan credit spreads wrapped in an unregistered DeFi token. Very new, with only ~400-500 active wallets against ~$597M TVL — implying heavy concentration in a few large holders; Figure formally disclaims issuing or endorsing wYLDS/PRIME. Treat as RWA private-credit DeFi exposure, not a T-bill cash substitute.
